page.overview:
Who is Snowmane?

Snowmane was the horse of King Théoden of Rohan in the late Third Age.

Snowmane was born of the horse Lightfoot. He was certainly weaker than Shadowfax, who was claimed by Gandalf; however, since his master was the King of Rohan he was most likely one of the Mearas himself.

In the Battle of the Pelennor Fields in TA 3019, Snowmane was hit by a black dart and fell onto Théoden, crushing him, leading to his death. The Witch-king's flying winged steed landed upon Snowmane's body, soon before Éowyn came and slew it.

After the battle, Snowmane was buried in a marked grave. On the gravestone was borne the inscription:, in the languages of both Gondor and Rohan:
